queryLines:
WITH white_mobile_5g_speeds AS (
    SELECT 
        digital_redlining.gold_all.fact_geo.geography_desc,
        digital_redlining.gold_all.fact_geo.geography_type,
        digital_redlining.gold_all.dim_race_proportions.white_prop,
        digital_redlining.silver_fcc.clean_mobile.mobilebb_5g_spd1_area_st_pct,
        digital_redlining.silver_fcc.clean_mobile.mobilebb_5g_spd1_area_iv_pct,
        digital_redlining.silver_fcc.clean_mobile.mobilebb_5g_spd2_area_st_pct,
        digital_redlining.silver_fcc.clean_mobile.mobilebb_5g_spd2_area_iv_pct
    FROM 
        digital_redlining.gold_all.fact_geo
    INNER JOIN
        digital_redlining.gold_all.dim_race_proportions ON digital_redlining.gold_all.fact_geo.geo_id = digital_redlining.gold_all.dim_race_proportions.geo_id
    INNER JOIN
        digital_redlining.silver_fcc.clean_mobile ON digital_redlining.gold_all.fact_geo.geo_id = digital_redlining.silver_fcc.clean_mobile.geo_id
    WHERE white_prop > 0.66
)

SELECT 
    AVG(mobilebb_5g_spd1_area_st_pct) AS avg_mobilebb_5g_spd1_area_st_pct,
    AVG(mobilebb_5g_spd1_area_iv_pct) AS avg_mobilebb_5g_spd1_area_iv_pct,
    AVG(mobilebb_5g_spd2_area_st_pct) AS avg_mobilebb_5g_spd2_area_st_pct,
    AVG(mobilebb_5g_spd2_area_iv_pct) AS avg_mobilebb_5g_spd2_area_iv_pct
FROM
    white_mobile_5g_speeds;
